messages:
alex: noticing a weird billing pattern: customer saw duplicate toolcall charges after a reconnect. session=xyz-77, suspect prefetch/resume overlap.

priya: can you paste the minimal trace?

alex: trace: ```
14:20:01 PREPREFETCH_CAPTURE session=xyz-77 shard=5 token=ephemeral-a1
14:20:03 CLIENT_CANCEL session=xyz-77
14:20:05 RESUME session=xyz-77 routed_shard=3 token=ephemeral-b2
14:20:06 PREFETCH_REPLAY session=xyz-77 chunk=0..128
14:20:06 TOOLCALL invoke_id=tc-9 session=xyz-77
14:20:06 BILL provisional session=xyz-77 tokens=95 source=prefetch
14:20:07 BILL provisional session=xyz-77 tokens=95 source=toolcall
```

mike: looks like resume replayed the same prefix and we also charged the toolcall separately. if the prefetch and toolcall overlap, we double-count. did the resume include a snapshot that duplicates the prefetch?

alex: yes. placement changed so resume hit a different shard and we had no stable origin id to dedupe.

liz: quick mitigation: console can surface "provisional overlap" where provisional ranges overlap by >10 tokens for same session id. ops can flag and refund fast.

priya: longer term we should add an origin/session fingerprint propagated across reconnects (X-Origin-Session), persisted in ledger items. then billing finalizer can collapse overlapping provisional ranges. but schema + pipeline changes required.

mike: low-risk interim: router should avoid re-emitting prefetch if a provisional ledger row with similar range exists within last 3s for that session id. else keep provisional until EOF finalize.

ops-bot: alert routed: billing-anomaly detected for acct=acme-io at 14:21 UTC.

alex: i'll prototype a router guard PR that checks recent provisional entries before replaying a prefetch.

liz: i'll add a small console column showing provisional vs finalized token delta per-session. should help ops triage.

priya: action list: alex -> router guard PR; mike -> spec for X-Origin-Session and trace fallback; liz -> console panel; i'll coordinate billing pipeline changes and small refund runbook. opening umbrella issue now.

alex: PR link when ready.

mike: uploaded draft spec: https://git.redwood.local/routing/origin-session-spec. includes header + fallback fingerprinting based on client-ip + user-agent when absent.

liz: sharing a screenshot in ~30m.

priya: postmortem notes: consider keeping provisional charges visible longer but mark them as "suspect dedupe" until finalization to avoid accidental refunds. also add small customer-facing explanation for rare reconnect double-bills.

alex: will follow up with postmortem and timeline once fixes land. thanks everyone.
